_about: Plain-language eval dataset (CORE-1169 part 1). ~60 public-domain (Project Gutenberg) passages, ~12 per difficulty type, tagged. Hard lines chosen to exercise the harness. Text is input to a difficulty scorer, not reproduced to users. named_hard_term cases exercise the named-term exclusion.
